exposure.needed: which backends send responses without a Content-Type header at runtime, and whether the routes serving them use a ContentType middleware

consequence.statement: Responses from backends that do not set a Content-Type header no longer get an auto-detected Content-Type value from Traefik.
consequence.remediation: Attach the ContentType middleware to the affected routers to turn Content-Type auto-detection back on.

assertion.statement: In Traefik v3, the Content-Type header is no longer auto-detected when the backend does not set it; auto-detection now has to be turned on with the ContentType middleware.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
